long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: Seeds that grow without permission still bother me, so I will find out how they manage it.
The bookshelf is where I learned about seeds, and the claim should be on record.
I will draw what I learned about seeds before I forget it.
The garden plot is mine to inspect, and I want to see whether anything there has started.
A patch of sun is the right place to rest once I have done enough thinking.

today.reason: The morning goes to seeds at the bookshelf and desk, a look at the garden, and a long nap in the sun, with plenty of slack before dusk.
